EmailTemplate.subject: (Reminder) Flywire's Dinner at HFMA Annual Tonight!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We're excited to see you at Flywire's Dinner at HFMA Annual! The Flywire team is excited to invite you to an evening at Rivea. We'll begin with cocktails and light appetizers at 6:30 p.m., followed by dinner at 7:30 p.m. We look forward to seeing you there!
‌ Directions: From Mandalay Bay Convention Center: Walk From the Convention Center towards Delano Lobby. Rivea is Located on the 64th floor of Delano. Use guest elevators to enter.
From the Delano Front Desk: Walk towards the valet and take a right down the hallway towards the guest elevators. Rivea is Located on the 64th floor of Delano. Use guest elevators to enter.
